questions: Should the function exclude non-numeric values from the last column before normalization, or should it exclude rows where the last column is non-numeric from the entire DataFrame?
If non-numeric values are excluded, should the DataFrame index be reset to maintain consecutive integer indices for plotting, or should the original indices be preserved?
Should the MinMaxScaler be fitted on only the numeric values of the last column, or on the entire last column (which would fail if non-numeric values are present)?
What should happen if the last column contains a mix of numeric and non-numeric values, but after exclusion there is only one numeric value (so normalization would result in a constant column)?
Should the plot include all rows of the DataFrame (including those with non-numeric last column values) or only rows with numeric values in the last column?
Is the function expected to handle datetime or other non-numeric but convertible types in the last column, or only strict numeric types?
Should the function modify the input DataFrame in-place or return a new DataFrame?
If the last column name contains special characters or spaces, should the title in the plot be escaped or used as-is?
